title: sister_used_my_parkour_world_as_a_grave
beats: My sister (24F) deleted my Minecraft world, and I found out why while I was mid-jump on a floating parkour course.
I'm (28F), I've been building this course for two years, it's my whole stress relief thing.
Last week I opened the world and it was gone, replaced with a fresh flat map.
She admitted it in the family group chat like it was nothing.
Turns out she'd hidden something inside that world eight months ago: screenshots of texts from her ex, proof he was cheating, evidence for her own sanity.
She said she panicked when she remembered it was still saved there and just deleted the whole world without checking with me.
Two years of parkour blocks, gone, so she could erase her own trauma archive.
I asked why she didn't just back up her screenshots elsewhere, and she called me selfish for caring about 'blocks' over her mental health.
My mom sided with her immediately, said I was being dramatic over a video game.
My dad quietly texted me that he still has an old backup from a family movie night a year ago, half the course survived.
I rebuilt what I could and posted the wipe as a warning to anyone who shares a world with siblings.
My sister still hasn't apologized, she just says I need to let it go.
So, Reddit... AITAH for being furious she nuked two years of my work without asking?
